commit_message: fix(firewall): order UFW dry-run flags correctly

replacements.new:
# Changelog

## v2.10.4

- FIX Firewall Manager 0.5.3: neaktivní UFW dry-run používá syntakticky správné pořadí `ufw --dry-run --force enable`. UFW parser zpracovává `--dry-run` před `--force`; opačné pořadí z 0.5.2 skončilo na fyzickém VM testu chybou `ERROR: Invalid syntax` ještě před živým enable.
- TEST regresní test nyní vyžaduje přesné pořadí parametrů dry-run enable. Živý `ufw --force enable` zůstává beze změny a rollback/acknowledgement kontrakt se nemění.

## v2.10.3

replacements.old: Status: **guarded manual UFW Apply implemented for VM verification** as SysApps 2.10.3 / Firewall Manager 0.5.2 (2026-10-27). Hub/hourly auto-apply and production/new21 takeover remain disabled. VM testing found and fixed the IPv6 UFW chain namespace mismatch: `before6.rules` requires `ufw6-before-*`, and preflight now validates the exact full IPv4/IPv6 candidate files before mutation.
replacements.new: Status: **guarded manual UFW Apply implemented for VM verification** as SysApps 2.10.4 / Firewall Manager 0.5.3 (2026-11-09). Hub/hourly auto-apply and production/new21 takeover remain disabled. VM testing fixed the IPv6 UFW chain namespace mismatch (`before6.rules` requires `ufw6-before-*`) and the inactive dry-run CLI ordering (`ufw --dry-run --force enable`); preflight validates the exact full IPv4/IPv6 candidate files before mutation.

replacements.old: - Module 0.5.2 owns local desired state in `/etc/jb_sys_apps/firewall.json` and may mutate UFW **only through the explicit guarded manual Apply/Enable/Disable workflow in `apply.py`**.
replacements.new: - Module 0.5.3 owns local desired state in `/etc/jb_sys_apps/firewall.json` and may mutate UFW **only through the explicit guarded manual Apply/Enable/Disable workflow in `apply.py`**.

replacements.old: Dry-run activation of an inactive UFW must use `--force` so the preflight itself never waits for UFW interactive confirmation.
replacements.new: Dry-run activation of an inactive UFW must use the exact argument order `ufw --dry-run --force enable`: UFW consumes `--dry-run` before `--force`, so the reversed order is invalid syntax. This keeps the preflight noninteractive without weakening the later live `ufw --force enable` guard.
